The '''Stinger electrostaff''' was a type of [[Electrostaff/Legends|electrostaff]] produced during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].
